title: KICC City Quest
description: Start at the top of the city and work your way down through the streets that built it. Tower, market, mosque, park.

tasks.label: Go up to the KICC rooftop viewing deck
Walk through City Market and find one thing made in Kenya
Pass Jamia Mosque on Banda Street
Eat street food from a CBD vendor
Finish at Uhuru Park with the skyline behind you

title: Karura Nature Quest
description: A forest with a waterfall, caves and clean trails, sitting inside a capital city. Half a day, no guide needed.

tasks.label: Enter through the Limuru Road gate
Walk to the Karura waterfall
Find the Mau Mau caves
Cover at least 5km of trail
Stop at River Cafe before leaving

title: Nairobi Museum Quest
description: Hominid fossils, a snake park and a tree collection, all within one walk on Museum Hill.

tasks.label: See the hominid fossil collection
Walk the Birds of East Africa hall
Visit the snake park next door
Cross to Nairobi Gallery for the Murumbi collection
End with a loop of the Arboretum

title: Karen Experience Quest
description: Colonial-era history, a giraffe at eye level and a long lunch in a garden. Karen at its slowest.

tasks.label: Take the guided tour at Karen Blixen Museum
Feed a giraffe at the Giraffe Centre
Watch beads being made at Kazuri
Have a long lunch at Talisman
Find a viewpoint of the Ngong Hills

title: Westlands Food Quest
description: Eat your way across Westlands, from morning coffee to nyama choma under the lights.

tasks.label: Start with coffee and pastry at Artcaffe
Eat whole fried tilapia at Mama Oliech
Try something you have never ordered before
Get nyama choma at K1 Klub House
Stay out past 22:00
